title: The social media detox that changed my life!
discussion_signal: A creator documents a one-week quit challenge and frames the result as less phone use, more offline time, productivity, presence, and motivation.
linked_research_question: How short-term non-use is experienced, what outcomes users notice, and whether a break becomes durable behavior.
engagement: 36,934 views and 1,400 likes in YouTube search metadata; visibility is not prevalence or causal evidence.
limits: Promotional and audience incentives may shape the framing
No control group or objective screen-time record retained
